1. (Currently Amended) A humeral implant comprising a first humeral surface component removably attached to a second component, wherein said second component is a stem with a connection mechanism that allows for selective attachment to said first humeral surface component.

2. (Currently Amended) The humeral implant of claim 1 wherein said first humeral surface component is a humeral surface and said second component is a removably attached stem that is configured to have a variable length.

3. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said humeral surface component has a coronal radius of curvature and an axial radius of curvature.

9. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface component is shaped to have a smooth articulating surface that is spherically or elliptically shaped. 

20. (Currently Amended) The humeral implant of claim 2 wherein said removably attached stem has a length that is adjustable, wherein said stem extends from a lateral cortex of said humerus to a center of a head of said humerus.

21. (Currently Amended) The humeral implant of claim 2 wherein said humeral surface component connects to said removably attached stem by a technique selected from the group consisting of morse taper and a threaded fastener. 

22. (Currently Amended) The humeral implant of claim 21 wherein said humeral surface component is affixed to said removably attached stem using at least one screw. 

29. (Currently Amended) A humeral bone implant comprising a modular implant with a humeral surface component and a stem that is adapted to be anchored in the epiphyseal-metaphyseal portion of a humerus bone.
